lemmas.statement: S and T are polynomial automorphisms with subtraction inverses and preserve the standard symplectic form by symmetric Hessian blocks.
The complete six-row gradient/support ledger in N^6 yields the displayed A matrix on the strict cone.
The two and only two selector margins are M_S=g-2-2x-2y and M_T=(2g-6)x+(g-6)y-6; no third face occurs.
C=B*A preserves the cone by the two ratio inequalities and the g=8..11 versus g>=12 height split.
The phase-labelled old-term induction gives v_(n+1)=A*u_n and u_(n+1)=C*u_n, with carried terms strictly dominated.
Positive coefficients in the characteristic-zero N-semiring cannot cancel selected Minkowski-sum support terms.
C-A is entrywise positive and q3 is visible and maximal, proving deg(F_g^n)=e_3^T*C^n*1 for n>=0.
Perron-Frobenius, the positive e3 observable, row sums, and the characteristic polynomial give lambda_1=rho(C)<(g-1)^2.
The mod-5 no-root table gives the stated irreducible degree-three subfamilies, and g=7 is recorded only as a strict-cone boundary with S gap 1.
